title: FluxBin: Flexible LUT-based Ultra-low-bit LLM Inference by Algorithm-Kernel Synergy
abstract: arXiv:2608.15602v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While binary quantization theoretically promises extreme compression and acceleration for Large Language Models (LLMs), existing research often overlooks the necessity of specialized hardware kernels, thus failing to unleash the full acceleration potential due to persistent reliance on expensive floating-point arithmetic or runtime dequantization overheads. To bridge this gap, we propose FluxBin (\textbf{F}lexible \textbf{L}UT-based \textbf{U}ltra-low-bit e\textbf{X}ecution with \textbf{Bin}ary bases), an algorithm-kernel co-design that synergizes post-training quantization with a highly optimized CUDA kernel. Algorithmically, we introduce Decoupled Row-Column Binary Decomposition to enhance representational capacity while maintaining hardware efficiency, complemented by a Hessian-guided saliency-aware hybrid bases that preserve critical information. translated_title: FluxBin：基于查找表的灵活超低位宽大语言模型推理——算法与内核协同设计
translated_abstract: 摘要：虽然二元量化在理论上承诺为大型语言模型（LLMs）带来极致的压缩和加速，但现有研究往往忽视了专用硬件内核的必要性，导致由于持续依赖昂贵的浮点运算或运行时反量化开销，无法充分发挥加速潜力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了FluxBin（基于查找表的灵活超低位宽执行与二元基），这是一种算法-内核协同设计，将训练后量化与高度优化的CUDA内核相结合。在算法层面，我们引入了解耦行-列二元分解，以增强表示能力，同时保持硬件效率，并辅以基于Hessian引导的显著性感知混合基，以保留关键信息。在内核层面，我们实现了一种带有尺度融合的查找表构建方法。
tldr: 本文通过算法-内核协同设计，结合解耦行-列二元分解和查找表构建方法，实现了超低位宽LLM推理的高效加速，克服了浮点运算和反量化开销的瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an algorithm-kernel co-design with decoupled row-column binary decomposition and lookup table construction to achieve efficient ultra-low-bit LLM inference, overcoming floating-point and dequantization overheads.
